content: रेचक {%a.%} (-चिका|{%f.%}) [रेचयति रिच्-णिच् ण्वुल्] .²1 Emptying, purging. .²2 Purgative, aperient. .²3 Emptying the lungs, emitting the breath. .{@-कः@} .²1 Emission of breath, breathing out; exhalation, especially through one of the nostrils (<ab>opp.</ab> पूरक which means ‘inhaling breath’, and कुम्भक ‘suspending breath’); प्राणापानौ संनिरुन्ध्यात् पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 32</ls>. .²2 A syringe; सिच्यमानोऽच्युतस्ताभिर्हसन्तीभिः स्म रेचकैः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 90. 9</ls>. .²3 Nitre, salt-petre. .{@-कम्@} A purgative, cathartic.
